sections.title: Doing something as a habit
sections.content: jár on its own means "to go/attend regularly" (like iskolába jár, "goes to school"). Put an infinitive in front of it and you get a habitual sport or activity: úszni jár ("goes swimming", as a regular thing), futni jár ("goes running"). You can also follow jár with a noun in -ra/-re: edzésre jár ("goes to training"). Either way, jár signals that this happens again and again, not just once.

items.english: I go swimming on Mondays and Wednesdays.
The team goes to training on Thursdays.

sections.content: sportolok already means "I do sport" right now, in general. Adding jár (sportolni járok) sharpens that into "I go and do sport, as a regular habit" — useful whenever the schedule matters, not just the activity.
